title: Several moderate signals on a trusted device: foreign VPN, a burst of purchases, a larger amount
narrative: A $640 electronics order from the customer's trusted device. It is the third to fifth purchase in the past hour, the amount is about one and a half times their 30-day average, and the IP is a VPN exit in a different country from the billing address.
rationale: Three independent moderate signals call for a human look. The trusted device argues against an automatic decline; the combination argues against an automatic approval.
